commands.command: python3 -m compileall -q app/platform_adapter app/main.py app/engine/monitor.py tests

scenarios.name: adapter registry returns explicit capability matrix
scenarios.given: fake adapters for douyin, xiaohongshu, kuaishou, channels are registered
scenarios.then: response lists each platform and all capability booleans explicitly

scenarios.name: unsupported capability fails with standard error
scenarios.when: a public content fetch is requested for channels
scenarios.then: service returns PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED and creates no success task

scenarios.name: credential material is redacted
scenarios.given: an account has credential_ref, proxy_ref, and runtime_profile_ref
scenarios.when: account health or capabilities are returned
scenarios.then: no cookie, storage_state, proxy password, or profile directory appears in API output
scenarios.evidence: contracts avoid exposing credential fields; production vault/API redaction remains follow-up

scenarios.name: write task requires idempotency and audit fields
scenarios.given: a publish or social action request
scenarios.then: request is rejected before adapter invocation
scenarios.evidence: requires future production task schema; current creatorhub legacy tasks do not yet enforce idempotency

scenarios.name: creatorhub content normalizer removes platform-biased field names
scenarios.given: sample Aweme/MediaItem style data from creatorhub
scenarios.then: output uses platform_content_id and platform_extra instead of aweme_id/sec_uid as global fields

scenarios.name: adapter degraded state is visible
scenarios.then: status is degraded with safe last_error_code and no sensitive diagnostics inline
scenarios.evidence: adapter health endpoint not implemented in this slice

scenarios.name: xiaohongshu adapter is registered as concrete adapter
scenarios.then: registry returns XiaohongshuAdapter with keyword and publish capabilities

scenarios.name: xiaohongshu keyword resolution is network-free
scenarios.then: TargetRef is returned without platform network dependency

scenarios.name: adapter task runtime delegates XHS scan/comment/publish/comment-post helpers
scenarios.when: runtime scan, comment fetch, publish, comment post, target discovery, and media refresh helpers run
scenarios.then: runtime returns normalized legacy-compatible results without engine platform internals
